title: Many tools, one request
note: text = subtitles; say = spelled for the voice. Numbers: experiments/logs/our_harness.json run order_hands (our harness, gemini-3.8-flash, the HANDS_L4 prompt with no codes), claude_harness.json runs.order_hands (Claude Code + our MCP server, claude-sonnet-5.5, HANDS_L4 appended); the earlier direct-order refusal from our_harness.json run order and claude_harness.json runs.order (findings).

blocks.text: Emma's full order: I need 2,000 of the 36 V 500 Wh battery packs from Voltway for the spring launch run. No codes at all, and sixteen tools on the shelf. Which does the model call, and in what order?
blocks.say: Emma's full order: I need two thousand of the thirty-six volt, five hundred watt-hour battery packs from Voltway, for the spring launch run. No codes at all, and sixteen tools on the shelf. Which does the model call, and in what order?

blocks.text: On our harness, the model picks every next call. The first three go out at once: find_item, find_supplier, check_budget. The pack is BAT-500. The supplier, Voltway Cells. The spring launch run, PRD-07.
blocks.say: On our harness, the model picks every next call. The first three go out at once: find item, find supplier, check budget. The pack is bat five hundred. The supplier, Voltway Cells. The spring launch run, P R D zero seven.

blocks.text: Then the budget, and the policy: an order this size goes to Daniel. A second search, for a need-by date, finds nothing. Then the stock: 5,400 in Manchester.
blocks.say: Then the budget, and the policy: an order this size goes to Daniel. A second search, for a need-by date, finds nothing. Then the stock: five thousand four hundred in Manchester.

blocks.text: Here it slips: it previews the request with a date it made up, 1 February 2027. A preview saves nothing. It checks the UN 38.3 certificate, then asks Emma for the date.
blocks.say: Here it slips: it previews the request with a date it made up, the first of February, twenty twenty-seven. A preview saves nothing. It checks the U N thirty-eight point three certificate, then asks Emma for the date.

blocks.text: She says 9 November. A second preview, then her yes, and only then does the request go in: PR/2026/04417, waiting for Daniel. Eleven calls.
blocks.say: She says the ninth of November. A second preview, then her yes, and only then does the request go in: request four four one seven, waiting for Daniel. Eleven calls.

blocks.text: Tools catch mistakes too. In an earlier run, both harnesses tried a direct order first. The tool refused: a direct order is limited to £50,000; this one is £285,600. Its next step said: raise a purchase request. They did.
blocks.say: Tools catch mistakes too. In an earlier run, both harnesses tried a direct order first. The tool refused: a direct order is limited to fifty thousand pounds; this one is two hundred and eighty-five thousand, six hundred. Its next step said: raise a purchase request. They did.

blocks.text: Now the same three messages on Claude's harness: Claude Code, on our MCP server. Claude orders the calls itself: 8 calls, no policy search, and the same request at the end.
blocks.say: Now the same three messages on Claude's harness: Claude Code, on our M C P server. Claude orders the calls itself: eight calls, no policy search, and the same request at the end.

blocks.text: In both, the model picks the next call. Around it, Claude's harness runs Anthropic's own prompt and loop. In ours, we set the model, the prompt, the tools Emma sees, a battery-safety check before every write, a 14-round limit, and a log of every token: 34,984, about 2.6 pence.
blocks.say: In both, the model picks the next call. Around it, Claude's harness runs Anthropic's own prompt and loop. In ours, we set the model, the prompt, the tools Emma sees, a battery-safety check before every write, a fourteen-round limit, and a log of every token: thirty-four thousand, nine hundred and eighty-four, about two point six pence.

blocks.text: Many tools, one request. The model chooses the next step. The harness decides what it can choose from.
blocks.say: Many tools, one request. The model chooses the next step. The harness decides what it can choose from.
